== Summary ==
Identified: none. Left: the teammate with glasses, a reddish beard, and a tan fleece vest (same man as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 2.jpg]], [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 18.jpg]], and the back seat of [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 26.jpg]]).
